notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Composite Golem.
description:
Cast Departed Soulkeeper from your graveyard by paying it's disturb cost of {1}{W}{U}.
Departed Soulkeeper enters the battlefield as a copy of Composite Golem.
Activate Departed Soulkeeper by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
